corrected_value.title: Commitment to the profession of ELT and an organization: A profile of expat faculty in South Korea.

decisions.quote: Similarly, based on a prior study (Moodie, 2023), Hypothesis 6 expected higher affective and normative commitment among NESTs with formal teacher qualifications. These results did not replicate, indicating that teacher qualifications do not necessarily translate into stronger commitment profiles among expatriate NESTs.
decisions.reason: Hypothesis 6 directly retests Moodie (2023)'s teacher-qualification commitment finding and the discussion states that these results did not replicate. The reference identifies DOI 10.1177/1362168820938814. The sole shipped pair is McInerney et al. (2015), a different paper. Parent reviewed the cited results/purpose and reference identity against all supplied shipped originals. This decision confirms the missing paper-level pair only; its overall outcome has not been adjudicated.
